meta.name: discovery-interview-prep
meta.description: Plan customer discovery interviews with the right goal, segment, constraints, and method. Use when preparing interviews for problem validation, churn research, or new product ideas.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规划客户发现访谈，明确目标、分群、约束和方法
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在为产品决策准备用户访谈
copy.tagline_en: Plan customer discovery interviews with clear goals, segments, and methods
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to prepare user interviews for product decisions

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会引导你完成客户探索访谈的准备。它会询问研究目标、客户细分、限制条件和访谈方法，然后生成定制计划，包含面试框架、问题列表和成功标准。
howto.when: 当你说需要准备客户探索访谈时触发，比如验证问题、研究用户流失或评估新想法。

say.text: 我想验证一个新问题的痛点。
say.note: Claude 会一步步引导你完成访谈准备。

say.text: 我需要访谈最近流失的5家企业客户。
say.note: Claude 会基于约束推荐合适的访谈方法。

say.text: 我想了解用户为什么没有激活核心功能。
say.note: Claude 会帮你设计问题并提醒要避免的偏见。

howto.what_en: Claude will guide you through preparing customer discovery interviews. It asks about research goals, customer segments, constraints, and methodologies, then generates a tailored interview plan with framework, questions, and success criteria.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say you need to prepare customer discovery interviews, e.g., for problem validation, churn research, or new product ideas.

say_en.text: I want to validate a new problem's pain point.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you step by step.

say_en.text: I need to interview 5 recently churned enterprise customers.
say_en.note: Claude will recommend methods based on constraints.

say_en.text: I want to understand why users aren't activating the core feature.
say_en.note: Claude will help design questions and highlight biases.
